svg.aria-label: Ricart-Agrawala mutual exclusion: Ask everybody, enter when everybody has answered, and answer the ones you kept waiting.. ⟨REQUEST, my timestamp⟩; ⟨REPLY⟩ at once; ⟨REQUEST, my timestamp⟩; my request is older: defer the reply; every reply in: enter the critical section; on leaving: ⟨REPLY⟩ to the deferred one. Timestamps order the requests and every pair of processes agrees on that order, so only one can be inside.
